name: nvaex-jev-core
description: System-1 router and discipline set: Stage-0 STT readback, JEV router that asks TypeSafe Jev for level and group (keyword rules as fallback) with decision memory, jev-rea-mcp server (3 tools), task auditor, verification/debug/plan/fail-loud skills, decision gate, spec check, delegation, backlog, peer sessions, 26-check non-blocking dark-pattern scorecard.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key from console.typesafe.ai/keys, used by the JEV router. Kept in secure storage. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment, or to route with the local keyword rules only.
